title: 第11章 找茬做局第12章 狗尿胡同
content_zh:
几日后清晨。
路沉正在梅树下练拳。
刘奇引着一人跌撞进院，来人是路沉手下秃子。
“路兄弟，你这朋友急着找你。”刘奇道。
路沉拳风一收，见秃子脸色煞白，心头一沉“出什么事了？”
“老大，咱们的摊子让人砸了。”秃子急声道。
路沉眼神倏地一冷，一言不发，抬步就往回走。
秃子小跑随在一旁，途中急急说道
“今早李德海来玩彩，先试了几文，没中。后来竟掏出一两银子要下大注！
瞎哥瞧数目太大，赔不起，叫他去赌坊玩，那老货竟耍起横来，一把将银子扔进钱箱里。
结果开出来又没中，他竟当场耍赖，非说自己中了。旁边几个泼皮也跟着作证，咬定他押中了彩头。”
闻言，路沉面色阴沉，闷头赶回羊圈街。
刚到街口，就瞧见李德海揪着馄饨摊老孙头的衣领，唾沫星子横飞
“你给老子听好了！当时你就在边上，亲眼看见我押中了彩！要是敢昧着良心说瞎话，等我儿子从青河门回来，看他怎么收拾你！”
老孙头被他勒得面色发青。
青河门在偌大的江湖上，顶多算是个二流门派，可是在文安县这小地方，连县太爷都要让他们三分。
老孙头既不敢得罪李河海，又不愿昧良心扯谎，一张脸憋得通红。
他一个摆摊的，哪边都开罪不起。
“够了！李德海，你真以为我们是好惹的？”
瞎子阴恻恻地喝道。

在他身后，拴虎等人一言不发，只利落地亮出了刀子。
拴虎他们用的是攮子刀，市井最常见的凶器。
长一尺余，打造粗糙，用料少，花上几十文钱就能在铁匠铺弄来一把，方便藏匿，袖里、腰间皆可顺手拔出。
这种街头搏命的武器，刀锋窄而利。
即便在这寒冬腊月，也能轻易将厚实的皮袄捅个对穿。
李德海见拴虎他们竟真敢动刀子，吓得一哆嗦，慌忙松开了老孙头，踉跄着向后连退数步。
他身旁那些起哄的泼皮们也顿时噤声，脚底悄悄往后挪。
可四周围观的闲汉们却个个伸长了脖子，生怕错过一丝动静，心里巴不得场面越乱越好，只嫌血光溅得不够快。
李德海这会儿也有点怕了。
“别、别乱来，我儿是青河门弟子，得罪了我，就是得罪青河门，你们可要想清楚”李德海色厉内荏道。
“呸，大不了赔你一条命！”瞎子啐了一口，反手亮出攮子。
他逼上前，李德海被那亡命徒似的架势吓得魂飞魄散，两腿一软，烂泥般瘫在地上。
眼看瞎子就要下死手，一声暴喝如惊雷炸响
“住手！”
瞎子的动作猛地一滞，攮子的刀尖随之颓然垂落。
这一刻能喝住他的，只有路沉。
路沉目光冷冽如刀，缓步上前，围观的看热闹的赶紧散开，给他让出一条道。
他瞥了眼瘫软在地的李德海，随即抬起眼，目光越过攒动的人头，死死钉在了不远处，倚墙而立的韩老五身上。
韩老五嘴角似笑非笑，俨然一副看客模样。
路沉断定，此事定然与他脱不了干系。
content_en:
Early morning a few days later.
Lu Chen is practicing boxing under the plum tree.
Liu Qi led someone to stumble into the hospital. The person who came was Lu Chen's bald man.
"Brother Lu, your friend is eager to find you." Liu Qidao.
Lu Chen withdrew his fist and saw that the bald man's face was pale, and his heart sank, "What happened?"
"Boss, our stall was smashed." Baldy said anxiously.
Lu Chen's eyes suddenly turned cold, and he walked back without saying a word.
The bald man trotted beside him and said hurriedly on the way
"Li Dehai came to play lottery this morning. He tried a few words but failed. Then he actually took out a tael of silver and wanted to place a big bet!
The blind brother saw that the amount was too big and he couldn't afford to lose it, so he asked him to go to the gambling house to play. The old guy actually got into trouble and threw the money into the cash box.
As a result, he missed again, so he lied on the spot, claiming that he had hit the ball. Several gangsters nearby also testified, insisting that he had won the lottery. "
Hearing this, Lu Chen looked gloomy and hurried back to Yangquan Street.
As soon as he arrived at the street, he saw Li Dehai grabbing the wonton stall owner Suntou by his collar and spitting all over him.
"Listen to me! You were nearby at that time and saw with your own eyes that I won the lottery! If you dare to tell lies without conscience, wait until my son comes back from Qinghe Gate and see how he deals with you!"
Lao Sun's head was so strangled that he turned blue.
Qinghe Sect is at best a second-rate sect in the vast arena, but in a small place like Wen'an County, even the county magistrate wants to give them a third.
Lao Suntou neither dared to offend Li Hehai, nor wanted to lie against his conscience, so his face turned red from suppressing it.
As a stall keeper, he can't afford to offend anyone.
"That's enough! Li Dehai, do you really think we are easy to mess with?"
The blind man shouted sadly.
Behind him, Shuanhu and the others said nothing, only showed their knives neatly.
They used a Taozi knife to tie up the tiger, the most common murder weapon in the market.
It is more than a foot long, rough to make, and requires little material. You can get one at a blacksmith shop for dozens of pennies, which is convenient for hiding and can be easily pulled out from your sleeves or waist.
This street fighting weapon has a narrow and sharp blade.
Even in this cold winter month, the thick leather jacket can be easily pierced through.
When Li Dehai saw that Shuanhu and the others actually dared to use knives, he trembled with fright. He hurriedly let go of Lao Sun's head and staggered back several steps.
The noisy scoundrels around him immediately fell silent and quietly moved their feet back.
But the idle people watching around all stretched their necks, fearing that they would miss any movement. They wished that the scene would be as chaotic as possible, but they just felt that the blood was not splattered fast enough.
Li Dehai was a little scared now.
"Don't, don't mess around. My son is a disciple of Qinghe Sect. If you offend me, you will offend Qinghe Sect. You must think clearly," Li Dehai said with a serious expression.
"Bah, the worst I can do is give you your life!" the blind man spat, and showed his stick with his backhand.
He pressed forward, and Li Dehai was so frightened by the desperado-like posture that his legs weakened and he collapsed on the ground like mud.
Seeing that the blind man was about to kill him, he shouted loudly like thunder.
"Stop!"
The blind man's movements suddenly stopped, and the tip of the knife dropped slumped.
The only one who could hold him back at this moment was Lu Chen.
Lu Chen's eyes were as cold as a knife, and he stepped forward slowly. The onlookers quickly dispersed to make way for him.
He glanced at Li Dehai who was lying limply on the ground, then raised his eyes, looking past the swarming heads, and fixed his gaze on Han Laowu, who was standing against the wall not far away.
Han Laowu's mouth seemed to be smiling but not smiling, as if he were a spectator.
Lu Chen concluded that this matter must have something to do with him.
